title: UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.30508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory is increasingly important for conversational agents, yet existing benchmarks primarily measure memory through pointwise factual recall: whether a system can recover isolated facts or event-level details from prior interactions. Real-world memory use, however, often requires a more demanding capability: integrating distributed, implicit, and noisy evidence across extended interaction histories into coherent, task-oriented outputs. We call this capability memory utilization. Here, we introduce UtilMem, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 1,717 instances across five domains, designed to evaluate four underexplored aspects of memory utilization: reasoning over dense histories, identifying implicitly relevant memories, synthesizing distributed evidence into summaries, analyses, or plans, and resisting interference from semantically similar distractors. translated_title: UTILMEM：面向长期对话记忆中证据利用能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 长期记忆对对话智能体而言正变得越来越重要，然而现有基准主要通过逐点式的事实回忆来衡量记忆能力：即系统能否从以往交互中恢复孤立的事实或事件级细节。然而，现实世界中的记忆使用往往需要一种更高要求的能力：将分布在长段交互历史中的分散、隐式且含噪的证据整合为连贯的、面向任务的输出。我们将这种能力称为记忆利用。在此，我们介绍UtilMem，一个诊断性基准，包含跨五个领域的1,717个实例，旨在评估记忆利用的四个尚未被充分探索的方面：对密集历史的推理、识别隐式相关的记忆、将分布式证据综合为摘要、分析或计划，以及抵御来自语义相似干扰项的干扰。我们对多样化的基于检索的和记忆增强系统进行了评估……
tldr: 该论文提出了UtilMem诊断基准，通过跨五个领域的1,717个实例，首次系统评估对话系统将长期交互历史中分散、隐式、含噪的证据整合为面向任务输出的“记忆利用”能力，涵盖密集历史推理、隐式记忆识别、分布式证据综合与抗干扰四个方面。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UtilMem, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,717 instances across five domains that systematically evaluates memory utilization in conversational agents—the ability to integrate distributed, implicit, and noisy evidence from long-term interaction histories into coherent task-oriented outputs—covering dense-history reasoning, implicit memory identification, evidence synthesis, and distractor resistance.
